name: Devabhai Jagariya
note: Devabhai Jagariya sings the songs of Kabir, Mirabai and other mystics and along with several other singers from his village and neighbouring ones keeps alive the tradition of ‘aradhiya bhajan’. He belongs to Kharoda village in Lakhpat, Kutch in western Gujarat.
